evidence_excerpts: The evaluation section reports that FDO inlining improves performance by 6% on average on Itanium, is slower than static in only 6 out of 116 best-case cases, and is more than 10% faster than static in 41 cases.
text: On the Itanium experiments, feedback-directed inlining improved performance by about 6 percent on average, with best-case FDO inlining slower than static in only 6 of 116 cases and more than 10 percent faster in 41 cases.
